get.description: q matches the title; visibility is draft, review, changes, published or hidden. review is the latest submission for review (null when the series was never submitted).
get.summary: My series, with a text filter and a visibility filter

post.description: cover / banner come from finished uploads (POST /creator/uploads). The slug is made from the title and never changes. secondGenre: another genre's slug or null (400 fields.secondGenre = unknown_genre / same_as_genre). ageRating: all, teen (13+), teen16 (16+) or mature (18+). updateDays: Mon ... Sun, each at most once (400 fields.updateDays = duplicate_day), sent back in week order. releaseHour: 0-23 in Asia/Phnom_Penh. fastPass: { on, ahead 1-5 }, default on with 3 ahead: the defaults for new episodes. commentsEnabled: default true. breakMessage: up to 120 characters, kept only while the status is hiatus.
post.summary: Create a series as a draft

delete.description: Only while none of its episodes was ever published (live, hidden, released or unlocked): drafts and scheduled episodes go with it. 409 has_published_episodes otherwise (such a series can only be hidden); 403 not_your_series for another creator's series.

get.description: 403 for another creator's series, 404 when it does not exist.
get.summary: One of the signed-in creator's series, as the edit form shows it

put.description: Send the whole series: a field left out or null takes its default. Leave the upload ids out to keep the current cover / banner. secondGenre: another genre's slug or null (400 fields.secondGenre = unknown_genre / same_as_genre). ageRating: all, teen (13+), teen16 (16+) or mature (18+). updateDays: Mon ... Sun, each at most once (400 fields.updateDays = duplicate_day), sent back in week order. releaseHour: 0-23 in Asia/Phnom_Penh. fastPass: { on, ahead 1-5 }, default on with 3 ahead: the defaults for new episodes. commentsEnabled: default true. breakMessage: up to 120 characters, kept only while the status is hiatus.

get.description: hiddenAt is set while the creator hides a published episode from readers; status hidden means an admin took it down.
get.summary: Every episode of the series, newest first, drafts and scheduled too

post.description: publish.mode is DRAFT, NOW or SCHEDULED (with publish.at, an instant in the future). Comics send imageUploadIds in reading order (at most 100, 200 MB), novels send blocks. fastPass null means free; otherwise 3-10 coins and free after 1-90 days (defaults 5 and 7). useSeriesFastPass true takes the series' Fast Pass instead (fastPass must be null, 400 fields.fastPass = not_with_series_fast_pass): on, 5 coins and free after ceil(ahead x 7 / max(1, update days)) days; off, free. number null takes the next free number.
post.summary: Add an episode (comic) or chapter (novel)

delete.summary: Delete a draft or scheduled episode

get.summary: One episode as the edit form shows it

put.description: Send the whole episode. A published episode stays published (publish.mode NOW); drafts and scheduled episodes can change mode. useSeriesFastPass true answers 400 fields.useSeriesFastPass = new_episodes_only. A hidden episode stays hidden.

post.description: Readers no longer see it, also those who unlocked it (no refund), until it is shown again; numbers don't shift. Hiding it again keeps hiddenAt. 409 episode_not_published for drafts and scheduled episodes, episode_hidden when an admin took it down.
post.summary: Hide a published episode from readers

post.description: Showing a visible episode changes nothing. 409 episode_not_published for drafts and scheduled episodes, episode_hidden when an admin took it down (only an admin can put it back).
post.summary: Show a hidden episode to readers again

post.description: Only for a series that went live once and was taken off (unpublish): a new series answers 409 review_required and goes through POST /{id}/submit. Needs a summary and a cover. 403 hidden_by_admin when an admin hid it; 409 already_in_review while it waits for a review, changes_requested while the admin's changes are open.
post.summary: Put a series live again that an admin approved before

delete.description: 409 no_changes_requested unless the series waits for changes (visibility changes), 404 item_not_requested when the admin did not ask for this item, 400 invalid_item for an unknown key.

parameters.name: item

put.description: Saved, so it shows on every device; marking it again keeps the first time. 409 no_changes_requested unless the series waits for changes (visibility changes), 404 item_not_requested when the admin did not ask for this item, 400 invalid_item for an unknown key.

parameters.description: contact, cover, title, age or images
parameters.name: item

post.description: draft or changes -> review: the series joins the admins' queue and goes live when an admin approves it. Needs a summary and a cover (400 with fields.summary / fields.coverUploadId = required). From changes, every requested change must be marked fixed first (409 changes_not_fixed). 409 already_in_review when it already waits, already_published when it is live; 403 hidden_by_admin when an admin hid it.
post.summary: Submit the series for review (Submit for review / Resubmit)

post.description: 403 hidden_by_admin when an admin hid it; 409 already_in_review while it waits for a review, changes_requested while the admin's changes are open.
post.summary: Take the series back to a draft

post.description: Returns a presigned URL: PUT the file to it with the given headers, then call POST /creator/uploads/{id}/complete. 400 for a type or size the rules do not allow.
